description.text: In a tunnel sunk in near-blackness, the

begins in deep shadow. Its headlights flare, and it pulls forward out of the dark toward the foreground. The beam edges catch the bodywork and glass, slowly resolving the car from a flat silhouette into readable surfaces. Light skates across wet asphalt and layered tunnel walls, sharpening the low, hollow space around the vehicle. The engine hum lifts from idle, tyres roll over the road, and the car's mass grows clearer as it advances into the edge of visibility.
